events.title: DEMO OUT NOW! + Some immediate hotfixes
events.summary: The Demo Is Out! 🐰 Our First Hotfix Hey there, debtors! The High Roller Penny demo is out now! ✨ What’s in the Demo? All kinds of balls — Big balls, small balls, Bowling Balls, and Bouncy Balls! Pieces with a twist — Blue pieces, Shockwave Pegs, Cloner Pegs that duplicate balls, and Jump Springs that send them flying! And most importantly… A new bunny girl, Leona, ready to hand you a crushing defeat! Enjoying the demo? Leave a review and let Penny know! 🩷🐰 For future updates and news about upcom
